_comment: Single source of truth for the API permissions (app roles) and Entra directory roles M365AutoRevocate's managed identity requires. Edit ONLY here: both Deploy-M365AutoRevocate.ps1 and Update-M365AutoRevocate.ps1 reconcile the managed identity against this file and grant whatever is missing (idempotent). appRoles[].resource is a key into resources. Adding a new feature that needs another permission = add a line here; the next deploy or update grants it. Granting still needs the operator to be Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator.

appRoles.reason: deleted users, manager, ownedObjects, subscription, revoke sessions, disable, licence removal
directory recycle bin, subscription on /users, exclusion group members
disable and/or delete the Entra devices a departing user owns
signInActivity for inactive-user detection (needs Entra ID P1)
disable sharing on the personal site via the tenant-admin CSOM endpoint (authorises against SharePoint, not Graph)
let Exchange accept the managed-identity token for mailbox-type reads (shared/room/equipment exclusion)
